payload.parent_proof_nl: For any real number x, frac(x) denotes the fractional part of x. By the defining identity for the fractional part, frac(x) is exactly the remainder after subtracting the floor of x, namely x - floor(x). Hence for every real x, frac(x) = x - floor(x).

parent_semantic_sketch.normalized_claim: For every real number x, frac of x equals x minus floor of x.
